# Verified Agent Workflows — Study 2

**Draft revision 6 · feasibility and estimation only · not launchable.** No scored runs have started.

Can a cheaper worker with supervision approach standalone Terra's delivery quality at lower cost? The focal comparison is **Terra supervising Gemma versus Terra alone**. GLM supervision, direct agents and the public-selected Gemma retry portfolio remain secondary comparisons.

Business targets are within 10 percentage points of Terra's completion rate at at most 50% of its standardized model cost per accepted result. These guide replication decisions; this sample cannot establish noninferiority or a purchasing recommendation. Core completion requires the frozen independent machine acceptance suite. Human patch review is an optional extension; merge readiness and review effort remain unmeasured until it runs.

## Fixed design

- **Harness:** common_OpenCode; every subject and supervisor uses OpenCode → LiteLLM → OpenRouter.
- **Tools:** shell/file/search, public Playwright checks and Context docs MCP with the same read-only documentation copy. Other MCP servers are excluded.
- **Application:** Vite React SPA plus separate Hono Node HTTP API; SQLite; Better Auth server sessions; same-origin proxy/static serving.
- **Sample:** 15 tasks × 2 trials × 5 systems; 165 scored generations including retry candidates. 40 separate calibration runs.
- **Deadline:** 120 minutes per workflow, fixed before calibration. Report deadline hits by arm and registered earlier-cutoff sensitivity.
- **Analysis:** task-paired estimates and descriptive 95% intervals; no confirmatory testing.

| Model | Requested ID | Provider candidate / reported quantization |
|---|---|---|
| Gemma 4 | `google/gemma-4-31b-it` | CoreWeave / fp4 |
| GLM | `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` | Relace / fp4 |
| Terra | `openai/gpt-6.1-terra` | Azure / not_disclosed |

[Provider readiness evidence](readiness/gemma-glm-zdr-20261107.md) records successful ZDR calls and remaining GLM tool/accounting gaps. Provider metadata is not proof of identical serving implementations or future availability.

## Blocking dependencies

- **corpus_reviewer**: independent corpus qualification by eligible human or model outside subject families; source selection and omissions reviewed
- **fixture_builders**: appoint eligible baseline/reference/check builders and qualifiers outside subject families
- **glm_accounting**: Relace reports reasoning greater than completion; establish actual native/billable mapping or register a provider revision with requalification
- **common_adapter**: pin all provider routes and qualify full OpenCode tool/usage/Context/broker path
- **fixture_and_corpus**: qualify baseline, calibration tasks, source corpus, evaluator and isolated DB authorization

**Optional extension:** blinded human patch review can later measure merge readiness and active review effort on frozen endpoints. It does not gate core setup, calibration or scoring. See [reviewer brief](REVIEWER_BRIEF.md); independent fixture/corpus qualification may use eligible humans or models outside the subject families.
